claims.excerpt: The 1906 earthquake has two magnitude estimates: 7.7 and 7.9
claims.label: F2
claims.sourceEvidence: The seismic analysis suggested a surface-wave magnitude of 7.7; the source verification identifies the geodetic result as moment magnitude 7.9.
claims.synthesisStatement: The synthesis gives 7.7 for the seismic result and 7.9 for the geodetic result, without specifying the magnitude scale for 7.9.
claims.narrativeStatement: The narrative presents the values as estimates of magnitude without identifying their different scales.
claims.explanation: The values are accurate, but omitting the surface-wave and moment-magnitude qualifications materially flattens a meaningful distinction and can imply the estimates are directly comparable on the same scale.
